name: codex-quota-hud
description: Shows an always-visible local black-and-green Codex quota HUD.

interface.shortDescription: Keep Codex quota visible in an always-on-top HUD.
interface.longDescription: Starts an always-visible black-and-green Windows quota HUD with full and compact one-line modes. It stays on top when you switch apps and reads rate limits through the local Codex CLI App Server.
